# Feature Request

## Description
Describe the feature you would like to see implemented. Be as detailed as possible about what the feature should do.

## Context
Explain why this feature is needed. What problem does it solve? What are the current limitations?

## Desired Outcome
What should the final implementation look like? Specify desired behavior, user flow, or specific changes.

## Examples (Optional)
If you have any links to similar features or examples, please provide them here.

## Implementation Notes (Optional)
If you have initial thoughts on how this might be implemented, feel free to include them.
